svg.title: How to add another computer
svg.desc: Each step you take, and what GridGate does for you: set up the Grid Asset Server first, then on each extra computer choose Region Server and type the server’s address.

g.text: Installs MariaDB and everything else it needs, starts the
GridGate service, and gives you a setup link
Plans what this computer runs: database, accounts
and inventory (Robust), and the admin website
Finds this computer’s address for you; this is the
address the other computers will join
Creates the databases, writes every settings file,
starts the grid, and makes your owner account
Picks a free square on the map, builds the region
and starts it, showing its progress
Then: each extra computer (repeat for every Region Server)
The same install as the server: MariaDB, the
GridGate service, and a setup link
Leaves out accounts and inventory: those stay
Reads the grid’s name, ports, version and hypergrid
from the server, shows them, and connects to it
Fills in this computer’s address and its first region
port, and offers another port if one is taken
Makes that avatar the owner of this computer’s
regions; no new account or password
Picks a free square on the grid’s map, builds the
region and starts it, showing its progress
Shows the login address to paste into Firestorm;
everyone shares one grid, one map, one inventory

svg.text: A Connected Server follows the same steps, but step 3 is “Connect to the other grid”: OSgrid is one choice.
